source_reference.warning: Reference-map geometry is a review prompt only. It is not copied into after_roof_labels.

label_definition.real_visible_change: A permanent change visibly supported by the fixed before/after imagery.
label_definition.mapping_only_or_not_visible: A reference-map difference that is not a visible permanent change in the fixed imagery pair.
label_definition.after_roof_labels: Human-drawn after-date roof outlines only; this review records visual outline alignment but does not duplicate the reference polygon.

labels.review_notes: Human reviewer confirmed a visible new building and reported that the reference outline identifies it very well.

required_properties.reference_candidate_ids: list of reviewed official-reference candidate IDs, possibly empty
